reading: Negative-to-neutral kinetic-only packet. Stable, but did not lift the style ceiling.
Slightly stronger content-preserving kinetic packet. Better than K_spatial, but still not a style-ceiling solution by itself.
Safety-corrected spectral kinetic packet. Stable under the machine contract, but worse on LPIPS than K_manifold and not a ceiling-lifting frontier.
Positive structure-aware OT control. Produces a meaningful low-LPIPS tradeoff by e5, but still trails the promoted Pattn/Stokes frontier.
Positive teacher-only smoothing control. Slightly improves the low-LPIPS tradeoff relative to StructOT at a similar style band, but still remains below the promoted Pattn/Stokes frontier.
Lower-batch barycentric endpoint packet. Shows the same strong style-ceiling signal as the b40 rerun with materially better LPIPS, but still remains far from the target LPIPS band.
Strong style-ceiling packet. Reaches near-target style, but content damage remains catastrophic.
Positive queue-side smoothing control. Recovers into the StructOT and EndpointTeacher tradeoff band by e5, but still does not displace the promoted Pattn/Stokes frontier.
Strong-family queue escalation. Stays near the plain Pattn style band, but does not materially improve the LPIPS frontier over the promoted late-Stokes family.
Strong low-LPIPS successor line. Does not beat the style frontier, but becomes the new best content-preserving tradeoff point among the promoted successor families.
Snapshot-matched repaired x-pred packet. Clearly stronger than XPred_Barycenter on both style and LPIPS, but still far from the LPIPS target band.
Snapshot-matched proximal-only repair attempt. Clean negative result: weaker than XPred_Barycenter and much weaker than XPred_Kmanifold on both style and LPIPS.
Snapshot-matched combo repair attempt. Strong negative result: adding the current high-pass residual branch on top of Kmanifold degrades both style and LPIPS.
Snapshot-matched modulation repair attempt. Better than the high-pass residual family, but still worse than XPred_Kmanifold on both style and LPIPS.
First promoted cross-attention proximal frontier. Beats XPred_Kmanifold on both style and LPIPS.
Longer-training continuation of the promoted Pattn family. Keeps style flat and further improves LPIPS.
Late weak-Stokes fine-tune from the promoted Pattn continuation. Keeps style within the promoted band while improving LPIPS enough to become the new selected frontier.
Late weaker-Stokes fine-tune from the promoted Pattn continuation. Raises the raw style frontier above the 0.05 packet, but gives back part of its LPIPS gain.
Lower-LPIPS early tradeoff, but not a promoted frontier because style drops too far and later epochs degrade.
Cleaner LPIPS-oriented tradeoff than Aniso, but still not a promoted frontier over the Pattn continuation.
Longer-training continuation of the Stokes tradeoff family. Keeps pushing LPIPS down, but style drops enough that it remains an alternative tradeoff rather than the promoted frontier.
